verdict.rationale: Alma is a law firm for companies as well as individuals. It sells a flat-fee H-1B Change of Employer (transfer) service and business-tier program management for 26–250 foreign nationals, and its H-1B guide covers the lottery and employer sponsorship. However, the evidence never documents LCA compliance or employer-side paperwork handling, and H-1B registration appears only as guide content and a 'Cap Subject Backup' mention, not as a service. Missing for 10: documented LCA filing/compliance service, an explicit H-1B registration service, employer paperwork scope (e.g., public access files, employer forms), and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a hiring manager, the provider supports the company side of sponsorship — H-1B transfers and registrations, LCA compliance, and the employer paperwork — documented as a service
